get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of companies with their associated establishments and legal entity information. Results can be filtered by company, establishment, legal entity code, date, and active status. The date filter applies at company, establishment, and legal entity levels — records are returned if updated on or after the specified date at any level.
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of companies with their associated establishments and legal entity information. Results can be filtered by company, establishment, legal entity code, date, and active status. The date filter applies at company, establishment, and legal entity levels — records are returned if updated on or after the specified date at any level.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Defines the current page of the paginated response (starts at 1)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Sets the maximum number of results per page (default: 50)

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description:
Company code identifier

**Referenced Table:** EMPRESA

**Referenced Column:** CD_EMPRESA

parameters.name: establishmentId
parameters.description:
Establishment code identifier

**Referenced Table:** ESTABELECIMENTO

**Referenced Column:** CD_ESTABELECIMENTO

parameters.name: legalEntityCode
parameters.description:
Legal entity CNPJ code in the legal entities registry

**Referenced Table:** PESSOA_JURIDICA

**Referenced Column:** CD_CGC

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Reference date to filter records updated on or after this date. Applies to company, establishment, and legal entity levels.

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description:
Filters establishments by active status.

`true` — Returns only active establishments.

`false` — Returns only inactive establishments.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of company establishments (empty content if no matches)

400.description: Invalid request parameters — pagination values out of range or malformed date

500.description: Internal server error — an unexpected error occurred
